# Information Security Program Management and Planning Standard

## 1. Purpose and Scope

This standard establishes requirements for information security program management, system planning, personnel security, and system and services acquisition at Acme Health. This standard applies to all organizational systems, workforce members, and external providers who create, receive, maintain, or transmit organizational information.

## 2. Information Security Program Plan

### 2.1 Program Plan Development and Content

Acme Health must develop and disseminate an organization-wide information security program plan that provides an overview of the requirements for the security program and a description of the security program management controls and common controls in place or planned for meeting those requirements. [NIST 800-53 PM-1 | ARC-AMPE PM-1 AE Mandatory]

The information security program plan must include the identification and assignment of roles, responsibilities, management commitment, coordination among organizational entities, and compliance. [NIST 800-53 PM-1 | ARC-AMPE PM-1 AE Mandatory]

The information security program plan must reflect the coordination among organizational entities responsible for information security. [NIST 800-53 PM-1 | ARC-AMPE PM-1 AE Mandatory]

### 2.2 Program Plan Approval

Acme Health must obtain approval of the information security program plan by a senior official with responsibility and accountability for the risk being incurred to organizational operations (including mission, functions, image, and reputation), organizational assets, individuals, other organizations, and the Nation. [NIST 800-53 PM-1 | ARC-AMPE PM-1 AE Mandatory]

### 2.3 Program Plan Review and Update

Acme Health must review and update the organization-wide information security program plan [Assignment: organization-defined frequency] and following [Assignment: organization-defined events]. [NIST 800-53 PM-1]

Acme Health must review and update the organization-wide information security program plan at least every one (1) year and following organization-defined events. [ARC-AMPE PM-1 AE Mandatory]

### 2.4 Program Plan Protection

Acme Health must protect the information security program plan from unauthorized disclosure and modification. [NIST 800-53 PM-1 | ARC-AMPE PM-1 AE Mandatory]

## 3. Senior Information Security Officer

Acme Health must appoint a senior agency information security officer (or senior information security officer) with the mission and resources to coordinate, develop, implement, and maintain an organization-wide information security program. [NIST 800-53 PM-2 | ARC-AMPE PM-2 AE Mandatory]

Acme Health must identify the security official who is responsible for the development and implementation of the policies and procedures required by this subpart for the covered entity or business associate. [HIPAA Security Rule 164.308(a)(2)]

## 4. Risk Management Strategy

### 4.1 Strategy Development

Acme Health must develop a comprehensive strategy to manage security risk to organizational operations and assets, individuals, other organizations, and the Nation associated with the operation and use of organizational systems. [NIST 800-53 PM-9 | ARC-AMPE PM-9 AE Mandatory]

Acme Health must develop a comprehensive strategy to manage privacy risk to individuals resulting from the authorized processing of personally identifiable information. [NIST 800-53 PM-9 | ARC-AMPE PM-9 AE Mandatory]

### 4.2 Strategy Implementation

Acme Health must implement the risk management strategy consistently across the organization. [NIST 800-53 PM-9 | ARC-AMPE PM-9 AE Mandatory]

### 4.3 Strategy Review and Update

Acme Health must review and update the risk management strategy [Assignment: organization-defined frequency] or as required, to address organizational changes. [NIST 800-53 PM-9]

Acme Health must review and update the risk management strategy at least every one (1) year or as required, to address organizational changes. [ARC-AMPE PM-9 AE Mandatory]

## 5. Planning Policy and Procedures

### 5.1 Planning Policy Development and Dissemination

Acme Health must develop, document, and disseminate to [Assignment: organization-defined personnel or roles] a [Selection (one or more): organization-level; mission/business process-level; system-level] planning policy that addresses purpose, scope, roles, responsibilities, management commitment, coordination among organizational entities, and compliance, and is consistent with applicable laws, executive orders, directives, regulations, policies, standards, and guidelines. [NIST 800-53 PL-1 Low | NIST 800-53 PL-1 Moderate | NIST 800-53 PL-1 High]

Acme Health must develop, document, and disseminate to organization-defined personnel or roles an organization-level planning policy that addresses purpose, scope, roles, responsibilities, management commitment, coordination among organizational entities, and compliance, and is consistent with applicable laws, Executive Orders, directives, regulations, policies, standards, and guidelines. [ARC-AMPE PL-1 AE Mandatory]

### 5.2 Planning Procedures

Acme Health must develop, document, and disseminate to [Assignment: organization-defined personnel or roles] procedures to facilitate the implementation of the planning policy and the associated planning controls. [NIST 800-53 PL-1 Low | NIST 800-53 PL-1 Moderate | NIST 800-53 PL-1 High | ARC-AMPE PL-1 AE Mandatory]

### 5.3 Designated Official

Acme Health must designate an [Assignment: organization-defined official] to manage the development, documentation, and dissemination of the planning policy and procedures. [NIST 800-53 PL-1 Low | NIST 800-53 PL-1 Moderate | NIST 800-53 PL-1 High | ARC-AMPE PL-1 AE Mandatory]

### 5.4 Planning Policy Review and Update

Acme Health must review and update the current planning policy [Assignment: organization-defined frequency] and following [Assignment: organization-defined events]. [NIST 800-53 PL-1 Low | NIST 800-53 PL-1 Moderate | NIST 800-53 PL-1 High]

Acme Health must review and update the current planning policy at least every one (1) year and following organization-defined events. [ARC-AMPE PL-1 AE Mandatory]

### 5.5 Planning Procedures Review and Update

Acme Health must review and update the current planning procedures [Assignment: organization-defined frequency] and following [Assignment: organization-defined events]. [NIST 800-53 PL-1 Low | NIST 800-53 PL-1 Moderate | NIST 800-53 PL-1 High]

Acme Health must review and update the current planning procedures at least every one (1) year and following organization-defined events. [ARC-AMPE PL-1 AE Mandatory]

## 6. System Security and Privacy Plans

### 6.1 Plan Development and Content

Acme Health must develop security and privacy plans for the system that are consistent with the organization's enterprise architecture, explicitly define the constituent system components, describe the operational context of the system in terms of mission and business processes, identify the individuals that fulfill system roles and responsibilities, identify the information types processed, stored, and transmitted by the system, provide the security categorization of the system including supporting rationale, describe any specific threats to the system that are of concern to the organization, provide the results of a privacy risk assessment for systems processing personally identifiable information, describe the operational environment for the system and any dependencies on or connections to other systems or system components, provide an overview of the security and privacy requirements for the system, identify any relevant control baselines or overlays if applicable, describe the controls in place or planned for meeting the security and privacy requirements including a rationale for any tailoring decisions, include risk determinations for security and privacy architecture and design decisions, include security- and privacy-related activities affecting the system that require planning and coordination with [Assignment: organization-defined individuals or groups], and are reviewed and approved by the authorizing official or designated representative prior to plan implementation. [NIST 800-53 PL-2 Low | NIST 800-53 PL-2 Moderate | NIST 800-53 PL-2 High | ARC-AMPE PL-2 AE Mandatory]

### 6.2 Plan Distribution

Acme Health must distribute copies of the plans and communicate subsequent changes to the plans to [Assignment: organization-defined personnel or roles]. [NIST 800-53 PL-2 Low | NIST 800-53 PL-2 Moderate | NIST 800-53 PL-2 High | ARC-AMPE PL-2 AE Mandatory]

### 6.3 Plan Review

Acme Health must review the plans [Assignment: organization-defined frequency]. [NIST 800-53 PL-2 Low | NIST 800-53 PL-2 Moderate | NIST 800-53 PL-2 High]

Acme Health must review the plans at least every one (1) year or following significant changes. [ARC-AMPE PL-2 AE Mandatory]

### 6.4 Plan Update

Acme Health must update the plans to address changes to the system and environment of operation or problems identified during plan implementation or control assessments. [NIST 800-53 PL-2 Low | NIST 800-53 PL-2 Moderate | NIST 800-53 PL-2 High | ARC-AMPE PL-2 AE Mandatory]

### 6.5 Plan Protection

Acme Health must protect the plans from unauthorized disclosure and modification. [NIST 800-53 PL-2 Low | NIST 800-53 PL-2 Moderate | NIST 800-53 PL-2 High | ARC-AMPE PL-2 AE Mandatory]

## 7. Rules of Behavior

### 7.1 Rules Establishment and Provision

Acme Health must establish and provide to individuals requiring access to the system, the rules that describe their responsibilities and expected behavior for information and system usage, security, and privacy. [NIST 800-53 PL-4 Low | NIST 800-53 PL-4 Moderate | NIST 800-53 PL-4 High | ARC-AMPE PL-4 AE Mandatory]

### 7.2 Rules Acknowledgment

Acme Health must receive a documented acknowledgment from such individuals, indicating that they have read, understand, and agree to abide by the rules of behavior, before authorizing access to information and the system. [NIST 800-53 PL-4 Low | NIST 800-53 PL-4 Moderate | NIST 800-53 PL-4 High | ARC-AMPE PL-4 AE Mandatory]

### 7.3 Rules Review and Update

Acme Health must review and update the rules of behavior [Assignment: organization-defined frequency]. [NIST 800-53 PL-4 Low | NIST 800-53 PL-4 Moderate | NIST 800-53 PL-4 High]

Acme Health must review and update the rules of behavior at least every one (1) year. [ARC-AMPE PL-4 AE Mandatory]

### 7.4 Rules Re-acknowledgment

Acme Health must require individuals who have acknowledged a previous version of the rules of behavior to read and re-acknowledge [Selection (one or more): [Assignment: organization-defined frequency]; when the rules are revised or updated]. [NIST 800-53 PL-4 Low | NIST 800-53 PL-4 Moderate | NIST 800-53 PL-4 High]

Acme Health must require individuals who have acknowledged a previous version of the rules of behavior to read and re-acknowledge when the rules are revised or updated. [ARC-AMPE PL-4 AE Mandatory]

### 7.5 Rules Content Requirements

Acme Health must include in the rules of behavior restrictions on use of social media, social networking sites, and external sites/applications; posting organizational information on public websites; and use of organization-provided identifiers (e.g., email addresses) and authentication secrets (e.g., passwords) for creating accounts on external sites/applications. [NIST 800-53 PL-4(1) Low | NIST 800-53 PL-4(1) Moderate | NIST 800-53 PL-4(1) High | ARC-AMPE PL-4(1) AE Mandatory]

## 8. Workstation Use

Acme Health must implement policies and procedures that specify the proper functions to be performed, the manner in which those functions are to be performed, and the physical attributes of the surroundings of a specific workstation or class of workstation that can access electronic protected health information. [HIPAA Security Rule 164.310(b)]

## 9. Security and Privacy Architecture

### 9.1 Architecture Development

Acme Health must develop security and privacy architectures for the system that describe the requirements and approach to be taken for protecting the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of organizational information; describe the requirements and approach to be taken for processing personally identifiable information to minimize privacy risk to individuals; describe how the architectures are integrated into and support the enterprise architecture; and describe any assumptions about, and dependencies on, external systems and services. [NIST 800-53 PL-8 Moderate | NIST 800-53 PL-8 High | ARC-AMPE PL-8 AE Mandatory]

### 9.2 Architecture Review and Update

Acme Health must review and update the architectures [Assignment: organization-defined frequency] to reflect changes in the enterprise architecture. [NIST 800-53 PL-8 Moderate | NIST 800-53 PL-8 High]

Acme Health must review and update the architectures at least every one (1) year or following a significant change to reflect changes in the enterprise architecture. [ARC-AMPE PL-8 AE Mandatory]

### 9.3 Architecture Change Reflection

Acme Health must reflect planned architecture changes in security and privacy plans, Concept of Operations (CONOPS), criticality analysis, organizational procedures, and procurements and acquisitions. [NIST 800-53 PL-8 Moderate | NIST 800-53 PL-8 High | ARC-AMPE PL-8 AE Mandatory]

## 10. Control Baseline Selection and Tailoring

Acme Health must select a control baseline for the system. [NIST 800-53 PL-10 Low | NIST 800-53 PL-10 Moderate | NIST 800-53 PL-10 High]

Acme Health must tailor the selected control baseline by applying specified tailoring actions. [NIST 800-53 PL-11 Low | NIST 800-53 PL-11 Moderate | NIST 800-53 PL-11 High | ARC-AMPE PL-11 AE Mandatory]

## 11. Personnel Security Policy and Procedures

### 11.1 Personnel Security Policy Development and Dissemination

Acme Health must develop, document, and disseminate to [Assignment: organization-defined personnel or roles] a [Selection (one or more): organization-level; mission/business process-level; system-level] personnel security policy that addresses purpose, scope, roles, responsibilities, management commitment, coordination among organizational entities, and compliance, and is consistent with applicable laws, executive orders, directives, regulations, policies, standards, and guidelines. [NIST 800-53 PS-1 Low | NIST 800-53 PS-1 Moderate | NIST 800-53 PS-1 High]

Acme Health must develop, document, and disseminate to applicable personnel and roles an organization-level personnel security policy that addresses purpose, scope, roles, responsibilities, management commitment, coordination among organizational entities, and compliance, and is consistent with applicable laws, Executive Orders, directives, regulations, policies, standards, and guidelines. [ARC-AMPE PS-1 AE Mandatory]

### 11.2 Personnel Security Procedures

Acme Health must develop, document, and disseminate to [Assignment: organization-defined personnel or roles] procedures to facilitate the implementation of the personnel security policy and the associated personnel security controls. [NIST 800-53 PS-1 Low | NIST 800-53 PS-1 Moderate | NIST 800-53 PS-1 High | ARC-AMPE PS-1 AE Mandatory]

### 11.3 Designated Official

Acme Health must designate an [Assignment: organization-defined official] to manage the development, documentation, and dissemination of the personnel security policy and procedures. [NIST 800-53 PS-1 Low | NIST 800-53 PS-1 Moderate | NIST 800-53 PS-1 High | ARC-AMPE PS-1 AE Mandatory]

### 11.4 Personnel Security Policy Review and Update

Acme Health must review and update the current personnel security policy [Assignment: organization-defined frequency] and following [Assignment: organization-defined events]. [NIST 800-53 PS-1 Low | NIST 800-53 PS-1 Moderate | NIST 800-53 PS-1 High]

Acme Health must review and update the current personnel security policy at least every one (1) year and following organization-defined events. [ARC-AMPE PS-1 AE Mandatory]

### 11.5 Personnel Security Procedures Review and Update

Acme Health must review and update the current personnel security procedures [Assignment: organization-defined frequency] and following [Assignment: organization-defined events]. [NIST 800-53 PS-1 Low | NIST 800-53 PS-1 Moderate | NIST 800-53 PS-1 High]

Acme Health must review and update the current personnel security procedures at least every one (1) year and following organization-defined events. [ARC-AMPE PS-1 AE Mandatory]

## 12. Workforce Access Management

### 12.1 Access Authorization and Implementation

Acme Health must implement policies and procedures to ensure that all members of its workforce have appropriate access to electronic protected health information, as provided under paragraph (a)(4) of this section, and to prevent those workforce members who do not have access under paragraph (a)(4) of this section from obtaining access to electronic protected health information. [HIPAA Security Rule 164.308(a)(3)(i)]

### 12.2 Workforce Authorization and Supervision

Acme Health must implement procedures for the authorization and/or supervision of workforce members who work with electronic protected health information or in locations where it might be accessed. [HIPAA Security Rule 164.308(a)(3)(ii)(A)]

### 12.3 Access Determination

Acme Health must implement procedures to determine that the access of a workforce member to electronic protected health information is appropriate. [HIPAA Security Rule 164.308(a)(3)(ii)(B)]

### 12.4 Access Termination

Acme Health must implement procedures for terminating access to electronic protected health information when the employment of, or other arrangement with, a workforce member ends or as required by determinations made as specified in paragraph (a)(3)(ii)(B) of this section. [HIPAA Security Rule 164.308(a)(3)(ii)(C)]

## 13. Access Agreements

### 13.1 Agreement Development and Documentation

Acme Health must develop and document access agreements for organizational systems. [NIST 800-53 PS-6 Low | NIST 800-53 PS-6 Moderate | NIST 800-53 PS-6 High | ARC-AMPE PS-6 AE Mandatory]

### 13.2 Agreement Review and Update

Acme Health must review and update the access agreements [Assignment: organization-defined frequency]. [NIST 800-53 PS-6 Low | NIST 800-53 PS-6 Moderate | NIST 800-53 PS-6 High]

Acme Health must review and update the access agreements as part of the system security authorization or when a contract is renewed or extended, but at a minimum at least every one (1) year. [ARC-AMPE PS-6 AE Mandatory]

### 13.3 Agreement Signing

Acme Health must verify that individuals requiring access to organizational information and systems sign appropriate access agreements prior to being granted access. [NIST 800-53 PS-6 Low | NIST 800-53 PS-6 Moderate | NIST 800-53 PS-6 High | ARC-AMPE PS-6 AE Mandatory]

### 13.4 Agreement Re-signing

Acme Health must verify that individuals requiring access to organizational information and systems re-sign access agreements to maintain access to organizational systems when access agreements have been updated or [Selection (one or more): [Assignment: organization-defined frequency]; when the rules are revised or updated]. [NIST 800-53 PS-6 Low | NIST 800-53 PS-6 Moderate | NIST 800-53 PS-6 High]

Acme Health must verify that individuals requiring access to organizational information and systems re-sign access agreements to maintain access to organizational systems when access agreements have been updated or at least every one (1) year. [ARC-AMPE PS-6 AE Mandatory]

## 14. Third Party Personnel Security

### 14.1 Personnel Security Requirements for External Providers

Acme Health must establish personnel security requirements, including security roles and responsibilities for external providers. [NIST 800-53 PS-7 Low | NIST 800-53 PS-7 Moderate | NIST 800-53 PS-7 High | FedRAMP PS-7 | ARC-AMPE PS-7 AE Mandatory]

Acme Health must require external providers to comply with personnel security policies and procedures established by the organization. [NIST 800-53 PS-7 Low | NIST 800-53 PS-7 Moderate | NIST 800-53 PS-7 High | FedRAMP PS-7 | ARC-AMPE PS-7 AE Mandatory]

Acme Health must document personnel security requirements. [NIST 800-53 PS-7 Low | NIST 800-53 PS-7 Moderate | NIST 800-53 PS-7 High | FedRAMP PS-7 | ARC-AMPE PS-7 AE Mandatory]

### 14.2 External Provider Notifications

Acme Health must require external providers to notify [Assignment: organization-defined personnel or roles] of any personnel transfers or terminations of external personnel who possess organizational credentials and/or badges, or who have system privileges within [Assignment: organization-defined time period]. [NIST 800-53 PS-7 Low | NIST 800-53 PS-7 Moderate | NIST 800-53 PS-7 High | FedRAMP PS-7]

Acme Health must require external providers to notify organization-defined personnel or roles of any personnel transfers or terminations of external personnel who possess organizational credentials and/or badges, or who have system privileges within twenty-four (24) hours. [ARC-AMPE PS-7 AE Mandatory]

### 14.3 Provider Compliance Monitoring

Acme Health must monitor provider compliance with personnel security requirements. [NIST 800-53 PS-7 Low | NIST 800-53 PS-7 Moderate | NIST 800-53 PS-7 High | FedRAMP PS-7 | ARC-AMPE PS-7 AE Mandatory]

### 14.4 Nationality Requirements Documentation

Acme Health must clearly document any nationality requirements for any account type within the platform, or explicitly state if none exists. [FedRAMP PS-7]

### 14.5 Business Associate Assurances

Acme Health must obtain satisfactory assurances that business associates will appropriately safeguard electronic protected health information created, received, maintained, or transmitted on the covered entity's behalf. [HIPAA Security Rule 164.308(b)(1)]

Acme Health must document the satisfactory assurances required by paragraph (b)(1) or (b)(2) of this section through a written contract or other arrangement with the business associate that meets the applicable requirements of § 164.314(a). [HIPAA Security Rule 164.308(b)(3)]

## 15. Personnel Sanctions

### 15.1 Sanctions Process

Acme Health must employ a formal sanctions process for individuals failing to comply with established information security and privacy policies and procedures. [NIST 800-53 PS-8 Low | NIST 800-53 PS-8 Moderate | NIST 800-53 PS-8 High | ARC-AMPE PS-8 AE Mandatory]

### 15.2 Sanctions Notification

Acme Health must notify [Assignment: organization-defined personnel or roles] within [Assignment: organization-defined time period] when a formal employee sanctions process is initiated, identifying the individual sanctioned and the reason for the sanction. [NIST 800-53 PS-8 Low | NIST 800-53 PS-8 Moderate | NIST 800-53 PS-8 High]

Acme Health must notify organization-defined personnel or roles within twenty-four (24) hours when a formal employee sanctions process is initiated, identifying the individual sanctioned and the reason for the sanction. [ARC-AMPE PS-8 AE Mandatory]

## 16. System and Services Acquisition Policy and Procedures

### 16.1 Acquisition Policy Development and Dissemination

Acme Health must develop, document, and disseminate to [Assignment: organization-defined personnel or roles] a [Selection (one or more): organization-level; mission/business process-level; system-level] system and services acquisition policy that addresses purpose, scope, roles, responsibilities, management commitment, coordination among organizational entities, and compliance, and is consistent with applicable laws, executive orders, directives, regulations, policies, standards, and guidelines. [NIST 800-53 SA-1 Low | NIST 800-53 SA-1 Moderate | NIST 800-53 SA-1 High]

Acme Health must develop, document, and disseminate to organization-defined personnel and roles an organization-level system and services acquisition policy that addresses purpose, scope, roles, responsibilities, management commitment, coordination among organizational entities, and compliance, and is consistent with applicable laws, Executive Orders, directives, regulations, policies, standards, and guidelines. [ARC-AMPE SA-1 AE Mandatory]

### 16.2 Acquisition Procedures

Acme Health must develop, document, and disseminate to [Assignment: organization-defined personnel or roles] procedures to facilitate the implementation of the system and services acquisition policy and the associated system and services acquisition controls. [NIST 800-53 SA-1 Low | NIST 800-53 SA-1 Moderate | NIST 800-53 SA-1 High | ARC-AMPE SA-1 AE Mandatory]

### 16.3 Designated Official

Acme Health must designate an [Assignment: organization-defined official] to manage the development, documentation, and dissemination of the system and services acquisition policy and procedures. [NIST 800-53 SA-1 Low | NIST 800-53 SA-1 Moderate | NIST 800-53 SA-1 High | ARC-AMPE SA-1 AE Mandatory]

### 16.4 Acquisition Policy Review and Update

Acme Health must review and update the current system and services acquisition policy [Assignment: organization-defined frequency] and following [Assignment: organization-defined events]. [NIST 800-53 SA-1 Low | NIST 800-53 SA-1 Moderate | NIST 800-53 SA-1 High]

Acme Health must review and update the current system and services acquisition policy at least every one (1) year and following organization-defined events. [ARC-AMPE SA-1 AE Mandatory]

### 16.5 Acquisition Procedures Review and Update

Acme Health must review and update the current system and services acquisition procedures [Assignment: organization-defined frequency] and following [Assignment: organization-defined events]. [NIST 800-53 SA-1 Low | NIST 800-53 SA-1 Moderate | NIST 800-53 SA-1 High]

Acme Health must review and update the current system and services acquisition procedures at least every one (1) year and following organization-defined events. [ARC-AMPE SA-1 AE Mandatory]

## 17. Allocation of Resources

Acme Health must determine the high-level information security and privacy requirements for the system or system service in mission and business process planning. [NIST 800-53 SA-2 Low | NIST 800-53 SA-2 Moderate | NIST 800-53 SA-2 High | ARC-AMPE SA-2 AE Mandatory]

Acme Health must determine, document, and allocate the resources required to protect the system or system service as part of the organizational capital planning and investment control process. [NIST 800-53 SA-2 Low | NIST 800-53 SA-2 Moderate | NIST 800-53 SA-2 High | ARC-AMPE SA-2 AE Mandatory]

Acme Health must establish a discrete line item for information security and privacy in organizational programming and budgeting documentation. [NIST 800-53 SA-2 Low | NIST 800-53 SA-2 Moderate | NIST 800-53 SA-2 High | ARC-AMPE SA-2 AE Mandatory]

## 18. HIPAA General Requirements

### 18.1 Reasonable and Appropriate Policies and Procedures

Acme Health must implement reasonable and appropriate policies and procedures to comply with the standards, implementation specifications, or other requirements of this subpart, taking into account those factors specified in § 164.306(b)(2)(i), (ii), (iii), and (iv). [HIPAA Security Rule 164.316(a)]

### 18.2 Documentation Maintenance

Acme Health must maintain the policies and procedures implemented to comply with this subpart in written (which may be electronic) form, and maintain a written (which may be electronic) record of any action, activity, or assessment required by this subpart to be documented. [HIPAA Security Rule 164.316(b)(1)]

### 18.3 Documentation Retention

Acme Health must retain the documentation required by paragraph (b)(1) of this section for 6 years from the date of its creation or the date when it last was in effect, whichever is later. [HIPAA Security Rule 164.316(b)(2)(i)]

### 18.4 Documentation Availability

Acme Health must make documentation available to those persons responsible for implementing the procedures to which the documentation pertains. [HIPAA Security Rule 164.316(b)(2)(ii)]

### 18.5 Documentation Review and Update

Acme Health must review documentation periodically, and update as needed, in response to environmental or operational changes affecting the security of the electronic protected health information. [HIPAA Security Rule 164.316(b)(2)(iii)]

## 19. Security Management Process

### 19.1 Security Violation Prevention and Response

Acme Health must implement policies and procedures to prevent, detect, contain, and correct security violations. [HIPAA Security Rule 164.308(a)(1)(i)]

### 19.2 Risk Analysis

Acme Health must conduct an accurate and thorough assessment of the potential risks and vulnerabilities to the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of electronic protected health information held by the covered entity or business associate. [HIPAA Security Rule 164.308(a)(1)(ii)(A)]

### 19.3 Risk Management

Acme Health must implement security measures sufficient to reduce risks and vulnerabilities to a reasonable and appropriate level to comply with § 164.306(a). [HIPAA Security Rule 164.308(a)(1)(ii)(B)]

### 19.4 Sanction Policy

Acme Health must apply appropriate sanctions against workforce members who fail to comply with the security policies and procedures of the covered entity or business associate. [HIPAA Security Rule 164.308(a)(1)(ii)(C)]

### 19.5 Information System Activity Review

Acme Health must implement procedures to regularly review records of information system activity, such as audit logs, access reports, and security incident tracking reports. [HIPAA Security Rule 164.308(a)(1)(ii)(D)]

## 20. Information Access Management

### 20.1 Access Authorization

Acme Health must implement policies and procedures for authorizing access to electronic protected health information that are consistent with the applicable requirements of subpart E of this part. [HIPAA Security Rule 164.308(a)(4)(i)]

### 20.2 Access Establishment and Modification

Acme Health must implement policies and procedures for granting access to electronic protected health information, for example, through access to a workstation, transaction, program, process, or other mechanism. [HIPAA Security Rule 164.308(a)(4)(ii)(B)]

Acme Health must implement policies and procedures that, based upon the covered entity's or the business associate's access authorization policies, establish, document, review, and modify a user's right of access to a workstation, transaction, program, or process. [HIPAA Security Rule 164.308(a)(4)(ii)(C)]

## 21. Facility Access Controls

### 21.1 Access Control and Validation Procedures

Acme Health must implement policies and procedures to limit physical access to its electronic information systems and the facility or facilities in which they are housed, while ensuring that properly authorized access is allowed. [HIPAA Security Rule 164.310(a)(1)]

### 21.2 Contingency Operations

Acme Health must establish (and implement as needed) procedures that allow facility access in support of restoration of lost data under the disaster recovery plan and emergency mode operations plan in the event of an emergency. [HIPAA Security Rule 164.310(a)(2)(i)]

### 21.3 Facility Security Plan

Acme Health must implement policies and procedures to safeguard the facility and the equipment therein from unauthorized physical access, tampering, and theft. [HIPAA Security Rule 164.310(a)(2)(ii)]

### 21.4 Access Control and Validation Procedures

Acme Health must implement procedures to control and validate a person's access to facilities based on their role or function, including visitor control, and control of access to software programs for testing and revision. [HIPAA Security Rule 164.310(a)(2)(iii)]

### 21.5 Maintenance Records

Acme Health must implement policies and procedures to document repairs and modifications to the physical components of a facility which are related to security (for example, hardware, walls, doors, and locks). [HIPAA Security Rule 164.310(a)(2)(iv)]

## 22. Device and Media Controls

### 22.1 Disposal

Acme Health must implement policies and procedures to address the final disposition of electronic protected health information, and/or the hardware or electronic media on which it is stored. [HIPAA Security Rule 164.310(d)(2)(i)]

### 22.2 Media Re-use

Acme Health must implement procedures for removal of electronic protected health information from electronic media before the media are made available for re-use. [HIPAA Security Rule 164.310(d)(2)(ii)]

### 22.3 Accountability

Acme Health must maintain a record of the movements of hardware and electronic media and any person responsible therefore. [HIPAA Security Rule 164.310(d)(2)(iii)]

Acme Health must implement policies and procedures that govern the receipt and removal of hardware and electronic media that contain electronic protected health information into and out of a facility, and the movement of these items within the facility. [HIPAA Security Rule 164.310(d)(1)]

### 22.4 Data Backup and Storage

Acme Health must create a retrievable, exact copy of electronic protected health information, when needed, before movement of equipment. [HIPAA Security Rule 164.310(d)(2)(iv)]

## 23. Group Health Plan Requirements

Acme Health must ensure that plan documents for group health plans provide that the plan sponsor will reasonably and appropriately safeguard electronic protected health information created, received, maintained, or transmitted to or by the plan sponsor on behalf of the group health plan. [HIPAA Security Rule 164.314(b)(1)]

Acme Health must amend the plan documents of the group health plan to incorporate provisions requiring the plan sponsor to implement administrative, physical, and technical safeguards that reasonably and appropriately protect the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the electronic protected health information that it creates, receives, maintains, or transmits on behalf of the group health plan. [HIPAA Security Rule 164.314(b)(2)]

## 24. Business Associate Contracts

Acme Health must ensure that business associate contracts provide that the business associate will comply with the applicable requirements of this subpart, ensure that any subcontractors that create, receive, maintain, or transmit electronic protected health information on behalf of the business associate agree to comply with the applicable requirements of this subpart by entering into a contract or other arrangement that complies with this section, and report to the covered entity any security incident of which it becomes aware, including breaches of unsecured protected health information as required by § 164.410. [HIPAA Security Rule 164.314(a)(2)(i)]
